description: Command: acknowledge one turn-ended notice of a session for one consumer (Hub #918). A consumer, such as the Pixoo module after a dismissal, sends it to the core with its own consumer ID. The envelope subject is the session's `id` (validator). The core (#831) adds the consumer to the notice's `acknowledgedBy` and publishes the session record at a new revision. Acknowledgments are recorded per consumer, and each consumer's policy decides which acknowledgments clear what it shows, as today (ADR 0012). An acknowledgment proves neither readership, success nor a cleared attention item. It replaces lifecycle 1.x's `notice.acknowledged` observation. The reply and the outcome use the profile's reply and outcome payloads.
